text:
maria: Quick heads-up: scheduling a rolling maintenance in az-east1 tonight to rebalance PSUs and recalibrate thermal sensors. Target window 2026-03-22 01:30-05:30 UTC. We'll do racks sequentially, ~20m drain + 10m validation per rack. Canary and cache-seed before each.

ashok: How many racks are we touching? any impact to Dedicated/reserved?

maria: 4 racks (rack-6..rack-9). We will avoid touching Dedicated/reserved pools unless we run into capacity pressure. Expected transient hosted capacity loss ~6-9% during each rack step.

tess: I'll own canary validation. What metrics should I post?

maria: P95 latency, error-rate, CPU/gpu utilization, and prefix cache hit %. Target: P95 <= baseline*1.5 and errors <0.5%. Cache hit >75%.

liam: Pre-seed caches for the rack prefix. Small cost but reduces tail latency. Suggest seeding 10M tokens across top prefixes.

sasha: Can we avoid autoscaler noise? Recommend pausing cluster-autoscaler for the duration of each rack drain. I'll add steps to the runbook.

maria: Good call. Runbook snippet:
```
# pause autoscaler
redwoodctl autoscaler pause --clusters=az-east1-hosted
# drain node
kubectl drain rack-6-node-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=900
# seed cache
redwoodctl cache seed --prefix="az-east1/rack-6" --tokens=10000000 --concurrency=6
```

ops-bot: Created ticket MNT-2026-1499: az-east1 PSU/thermal maintenance, window 2026-03-22 01:30-05:30 UTC. Pager scheduled 01:15 UTC.

oncall-night: One conflict: customer "NimbleAI" has a scheduled fine-tune 02:45-03:30 UTC in az-east1. Can we shift the rack sequence so their reserved hosts are untouched?

maria: We can reorder racks: start with rack-9 -> rack-6 -> rack-7 -> rack-8 to avoid NimbleAI's nodes. If they can't move, we'll exclude their reserved nodes entirely.

ashok: Also recommend we throttle background batch jobs during the window to reduce contention and avoid unnecessary preemptions. I'll flip a flag on batch-scheduler.

tess: Smoke checklist (I'll post results): 1) /health on 15 endpoints, 2) 200 sample completions, 3) 50 embeddings, 4) telemetry query for cache hit and pod restarts.

liam: Rollback/abort triggers: any canary with errors >1% OR P95 >2x baseline sustained across two sequential racks -> abort. Abort actions: unpause autoscaler, rollback routes to smaller quant model, re-seed cache, revert any network QoS changes.

sasha: Abort commands I'll use:
```
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --route=completion --model=redwood-small-quant --duration=30m
redwoodctl autoscaler resume --clusters=az-east1-hosted
```

maria: Updated plan: start sequence rack-9, rack-6, rack-7, rack-8. Preflight prep at 01:00 UTC (cache list, reserved-node map, batch throttle). Ops-bot linked runbook MNT-2026-1499. Please ack here if you're able to cover. :thumbsup:

oncall-night: Ack 1: I'll monitor and be on-call for the window. Ping me before each rack drain. :white_check_mark:

ashok: Ack. I'm available for autoscaler ops and batch throttle.

tess: Ack, will run smoke after each rack and paste short results.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll watch cost telemetry and advise if pre-seed volume needs adjustment.

maria: Thanks all 1 I'll post live updates to #eng-oncall and this thread during the window.
